SELECT A.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(A.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, A.DEPT_LEVEL, A.PARENT_DEPT_NO, A.WORK_AREA, (CASE WHEN (select count(hrd.deptid) from hr_department hrd where hrd.parent_dept_no = a.DEPTNO) = 0 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS open, ICONOPEN, ICONCLOSE, ICON "icon" FROM HR_DEPT_TREE_V A WHERE (A.DATE_ENDED IS NULL OR A.DATE_ENDED > SYSDATE) AND A.CPNY_ID = #CPNYID:VARCHAR# AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = A.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = A.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# UNION SELECT SUD.DEPTNO FROM SY_USER SU,SY_USER_DEPT SUD WHERE SU.USER_NO = SUD.USER_NO AND SU.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND SUD.DEPTNO=A.DEPTNO )

SELECT '''' || A.DEPTNO || '''' DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(A.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, A.DEPT_LEVEL, '''' ||A.PARENT_DEPT_NO || '''' PARENT_DEPT_NO, A.WORK_AREA, (CASE WHEN (select count(hrd.deptid) from hr_department hrd where hrd.parent_dept_no = a.DEPTNO) = 0 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS open, ICONOPEN, ICONCLOSE, ICON "icon" FROM HR_DEPT_TREE_V A WHERE (A.DATE_ENDED IS NULL OR A.DATE_ENDED > SYSDATE) AND A.CPNY_ID = #CPNYID:VARCHAR# AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = A.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = A.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# UNION SELECT SUD.DEPTNO FROM SY_USER SU,SY_USER_DEPT SUD WHERE SU.USER_NO = SUD.USER_NO AND SU.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND SUD.DEPTNO=A.DEPTNO )

SELECT A.DEPTNO, A.DEPTID, A.DEPT_NAME_ZH, A.DEPT_NAME_EN, A.DEPT_NAME_KR, A.DEPT_LEVEL FROM HR_DEPT_TREE_V A WHERE (A.DATE_ENDED IS NULL OR A.DATE_ENDED > SYSDATE) AND A.DEPTNO IN (SELECT E.ADMIN_DEPTNO FROM SY_ADMIN_DEPTID E, SY_ADMIN F WHERE E.ADMIN_NO = F.ADMINNO AND E.ADMIN_DEPTNO = A.DEPTNO AND F.ADMINID = #ADMINID:VARCHAR#)

SELECT A.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME_RESUME(A.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#,#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,#RESUME_NO:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, A.DEPT_LEVEL, A.PARENT_DEPT_NO, (CASE WHEN A.DEPT_LEVEL > 1 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS open, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_open.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_open.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_open.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_open.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_open.png') ICONOPEN, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_close.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_close.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_close.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_close.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_close.png') ICONCLOSE, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_close.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_close.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_close.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_close.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_close.png') "icon" FROM ORG_INFO A WHERE A.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND A.RESUME_NO = #RESUME_NO:VARCHAR# AND A.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY ORDERNO

SELECT A.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(A.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, A.DEPT_LEVEL, A.PARENT_DEPT_NO, (CASE WHEN A.DEPT_LEVEL > 1 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS open, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_open.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_open.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_open.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_open.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_open.png') ICONOPEN, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_close.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_close.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_close.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_close.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_close.png') ICONCLOSE, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_close.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_close.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_close.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_close.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_close.png') "icon" FROM HR_DEPARTMENT A WHERE A.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND A.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY ORDERNO

SELECT A.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(A.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, A.DEPT_LEVEL, A.PARENT_DEPT_NO, (CASE WHEN A.DEPT_LEVEL > 1 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS open, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_open.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_open.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_open.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_open.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_open.png') ICONOPEN, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_close.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_close.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_close.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_close.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_close.png') ICONCLOSE, decode(GET_CODE_NAME(A.DEPT_TYPE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#),'Company','/resources/images/dept/c_close.png' ,'Team','/resources/images/dept/t_close.png' ,'Group','/resources/images/dept/g_close.png' ,'Part','/resources/images/dept/p_close.png' ,'Sub-part','/resources/images/dept/s_close.png') "icon" FROM HR_DEPARTMENT A WHERE A.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND A.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY DEPT_LEVEL,ORDERNO

SELECT SEQ, CPNY_ID, CODE_NO, CODE_NAME CONTENT, ACTIVITY, ORDERNO FROM ORG_WORK_AREA WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND ACTIVITY = '14013912' AND END_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') ORDER BY ORDERNO

SELECT SEQ, CPNY_ID, CODE_NO, CODE_NO || ' ' || GET_COST_CENTER_NAME(#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,CODE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CONTENT, ACTIVITY, ORDERNO FROM ORG_COST_CENTER WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND ACTIVITY = '14013912' AND END_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') ORDER BY CODE_NO

SELECT CPNY_ID, DEPTNO, CODE_NO, GET_DESCRIPTION(CODE_NO) || ' -> ' || get_global_name(CODE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CONTENT FROM ORG_BUSINESS_RELATION A WHERE DEPTNO = #DEPTNO# AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY IS_DEFAULT DESC,ORDERNO

SELECT '''' || SP.CODE_NO || '''' DEPTNO, NVL(T.DESCRIPTION,'') DESCRIPTION, T.DEPTH, NVL(T.ORDERNO,'') ORDERNO, T.PARENT_CODE_NO, S1.CONTENT DEPTNAME, 1 DEPT_LEVEL, 0 PARENT_DEPT_NO, 'true' open FROM SY_CODE T, SY_CODE_PARAM SP, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1 WHERE T.CODE_NO = SP.CODE_NO AND SP.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND T.CODE_NO = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+)=#interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1
T.PARENT_CODE_NO IN (SELECT CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE WHERE PARENT_CODE_NO = #PARENT_CODE_NO:VARCHAR#)
T.PARENT_CODE_NO = #PARENT_CODE_NO:VARCHAR#
T.CODE_NO IN ( $include$ )
ORDER BY T.ORDERNO

SELECT '''' || EVS.CODE_NO || '''' DEPTNO, 2 DEPTH, 1 PARENT_CODE_NO, CODE_NAME DEPTNAME, 1 DEPT_LEVEL, 0 PARENT_DEPT_NO, 'true' open FROM EVS_PARAM EVS WHERE EVS.RESUME_SEQ = #RESUME_SEQ# AND EVS.PARAM_TYPE = #EVS_PARAM# AND EVS.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT '''' || DEPTNO || '''' DEPTNO, 2 DEPTH, 1 PARENT_CODE_NO, DEPTNAME DEPTNAME, 1 DEPT_LEVEL, 0 PARENT_DEPT_NO, 'true' open FROM EVS_OBJECT OBJ WHERE OBJ.SEQ IN (SELECT EVS.EVS_OBJECT_SEQ FROM EVS_AFFIRM EVS WHERE EVS.RESUME_SEQ = #RESUME_SEQ# AND EVS.AFFIRM_LEVEL = #AFFIRM_LEVEL# AND EVS.AFFIRMOR_ID = #adminID#)
